subject: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Timothy Garcia <timothy.garcia@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Maria Priest <maria.priest@priestlaw.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows

Tim — attaching our redlines for the MSA and the Order Form (see attachments). Primary open items from our side are:

- Notice window for termination (auto-renew and termination for convenience) — current customer ask: 90 days; our standard term: 60 days.
- Auto‑renew cadence — we redlined annual renewals with a 30‑day opt-out; customer requested 90 days to opt out.
- Termination for convenience — Acme asked for an unconditional right; we prefer a mutual right with usage-based proration and a cap on short‑term credits.

To keep the procurement timeline intact (signature target: end of January), can you confirm which of these items are deal breakers for you and whether your procurement team can accept a one‑time exception if we include a limited-scope sunsetting plan (data export + audit window) in the Order Form?

Next steps proposed:
1) You review our redlines and confirm any non-starters by 1/20.
2) If an exception is required, we escalate to Legal for a one‑time 90‑day notice exception tied to the sunsetting commitments.

Attachments: MSA_AcmeHealth_redline_20260112.docx, OrderForm_DEAL-8342_redline.pdf

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0172
From: Maria Priest <maria.priest@priestlaw.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Timothy Garcia <timothy.garcia@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows

Rachel / Timothy — quick thoughts from Acme counsel: 

- 90‑day notice is standard for us given regulatory signoffs; 60 days is tight, and procurement will push back.
- Termination for convenience without a clear sunsetting/data export obligation is not acceptable; we need a guaranteed export path and 180 days of log retention for a safe transition.
- Auto‑renew opt‑out at 30 days is short; we typically require 60–90 days to coordinate budget.

If Redwood can commit to: (a) a 180‑day audit/log retention commitment, (b) a documented export checklist and runbook in the Order Form, and (c) one‑time 90‑day opt‑out for this initial term, Acme will consider the Order Form acceptable.

—Maria Priest
Partner, Priest & Co.
maria.priest@priestlaw.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maria Priest <maria.priest@priestlaw.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Timothy Garcia <timothy.garcia@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 07:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows

Maria — thanks for the clear asks, that helps. Internal perspective and proposed compromise: 

1) Notice window: Agree to a one‑time 90‑day mutual notice for the initial term only (to accommodate procurement). After the first 12‑month term, revert to our standard 60‑day mutual notice for renewals.

2) Auto‑renew opt‑out: We can move opt‑out to 60 days for this deal (one‑time exception).

3) Termination for convenience / sunsetting: We will accept mutual termination for convenience with: 
   - Pro-rated invoice credits for unused pre‑paid committed months;
   - A cap on termination credits equal to 3 months of committed fees;
   - Commit to a documented export runbook and a 180‑day log retention window where logs required for regulatory compliance will be preserved; Redwood will not be responsible for third‑party migration work but will provide an export package (S3 export + manifest).

If Acme agrees to the cap on credits and the runbook/export scope above, Legal (Markus) has indicated he will entertain a 1x exception. Please confirm and we will circulate a clean redline reflecting the compromise.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations (contracts)
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows

Markus — forwarding the thread. Acme is a strategic pilot with potential for enterprise expansion in Q3; procurement needs a 90‑day opt‑out and stronger sunsetting commitments. Karthik has proposed a reasonable compromise (see his note) — can Legal sign off on a one‑time 90‑day exception with the credit cap and export runbook condition?

If we can get sign off today, Rachel will send the revised redline to Acme and it keeps us on track for the Jan close.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
—Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 20:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows

Laura / team — OK to approve a one‑time exception for Acme on the notice window and opt‑out timeline with these mandatory conditions:

1) The 90‑day mutual notice applies to the initial 12‑month term only; subsequent renewals will use our standard 60‑day mutual notice.
2) Termination credits limited to a maximum of three months of committed fees; no other refund or liability beyond that cap.
3) Add Order Form SOW attachment: "Sunsetting & Export Runbook" that lists the steps, expected export formats (S3 + manifest), customer responsibilities, and a 180‑day log retention commitment. The runbook will be attached as an Order Form Schedule and becomes a binding appendix.
4) Customer must acknowledge in the Order Form that Redwood is not responsible for third‑party migration services; migration work to be executed under a separate SOW if required.

I will circulate a narrow redline to the Order Form reflecting (2)–(4) and mark the MSA with the 1x notice exception. If Rachel confirms Acme accepts these terms, we can proceed to signature.

-Markus Klein
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.inference.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Timothy Garcia <timothy.garcia@acmehealth.com>, Maria Priest <maria.priest@priestlaw.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 06:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form alignment: sunsetting plan and notice windows

Tim / Maria — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per Markus (copied), Redwood can accept the one‑time 90‑day opt‑out for the initial term and the 60‑day renewals thereafter, plus the 3‑month termination credit cap and the Sunsetting & Export Runbook as an Order Form schedule.

Next steps:
- I will attach the updated Order Form and the Sunsetting & Export Runbook to the HubSpot deal and send you a clean redline by EOD PST.
- Please confirm acceptance after counsel review and we will prepare DocuSign for signature.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to the pilot.

Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
